clips.title: The story
paras: Above the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Spirit Rock draws Horde initiates to commune with the elements. A winding trail called the Hidden Path leads to this sacred crag.

Spirit Rock overlooks the red canyon where young Horde warriors and scouts train. The Hidden Path winds up the rocky ridgeline to this quiet altar. Aspiring shaman climb to the outcrop and drink sapta, a traditional brew that opens their senses beyond the physical world. They listen for the earth's rumblings and whispers.
